kpure01.title: Aries, Try Waiting Five Seconds
kpure01.caption:
One date in and Aries already had the 'so what are we' text loaded.
Uranus suggested a question instead, then five whole seconds of waiting. Who else is training for that record?

kpure02.title: Taurus, Same Table, Third Year
kpure02.caption:
Same booth, same order, year three, and neither of you wants to say it's a bit samey.
Keep the comfort and add one new thing. Ask what they've always wanted to try together.

kpure03.title: Gemini, Forty Texts Deep
kpure03.caption:
Gemini needed forty texts to explain one thought. Uranus suggested something wild: the call button.
The crush picked up laughing. Who is your friend that sends texts in bursts of ten?

kpure04.title: Cancer, Hints Aren't Words
kpure04.caption:
Baking, cleaning and sighing loudly so they'll notice you're hurt? Nobody can read a sigh.
Say it plainly and kindly: "I felt left out. Can we talk?" Most people want to know.

kpure05.title: Leo, Let Them Plan It
kpure05.caption:
Leo planned the light show, the speech and three outfit changes. Uranus had a better twist: let them do the spoiling.
Front row looks good on you, Leo. Who still needs to hand over the mic?

kpure06.title: Virgo Lets the Night Wander
kpure06.caption:
If your first date has a minute-by-minute plan with a graceful exit at 8:40, you're not alone.
Swap one slot for "wander." The best part of a night is usually the bit nobody planned.

kpure07.title: Libra Picks Something
kpure07.caption:
"Where to?" "Whatever you want!" Three rounds of that before Uranus stepped in.
Libra finally said tacos and the date was so relieved. Tag the friend who has never once picked the restaurant.

kpure08.title: Scorpio, No More Tests
kpure08.caption:
Replying slowly on purpose to see if they'll chase you? That kind of test doesn't build trust.
Ask straight: "I really like talking to you. Do you feel the same?" They might have been scared too.

kpure09.title: Sagittarius Books a Second Date
kpure09.caption:
Sagittarius will go anywhere with the crush, as long as it's before Friday. Uranus dared them to book a date next month.
They'd already marked it. Which of your friends is allergic to calendars?

kpure10.title: Capricorn, It's a Date Not an Interview
kpure10.caption:
Showed up to a first date with a clipboard of five-year-plan questions? Put it down for one minute.
Be a bit silly. Bad jokes and laughing together tell you more than any interview.

kpure11.title: Aquarius, the Most Unexpected Thing
kpure11.caption:
Aquarius tried a binary message, a banner in the sky and a twelve-clue riddle hunt. Even Uranus called it too weird.
The real twist was saying it plainly. Which one would you have tried first?

kpure12.title: Pisces, You Can Text First
kpure12.caption:
Wrote nine pages and still haven't sent "hi"? Big feelings don't need a big message.
Short and brave works: "want to get coffee on saturday?" They might be hoping you'll ask.
